_doc: Metro registry for `python -m metro fetch <id>`. Data, not code: one entry per metro. county_fips are 5-digit state+county FIPS codes of the CBSA (2023 OMB delineation, list1_2023.xlsx); state_fips are the 2-digit states they fall in; state_abbr maps each state FIPS to its USPS code (LODES and Census file names use it). downtowns are reference points (lat/lon) for the network builder. Optional keys: gtfs_include (Mobility Database source ids to use instead of the bbox search), gtfs_exclude (ids to drop from it), brt_name_pattern (regex on route names that marks a bus route as BRT), bbox_margin_deg (padding around the block-group centroids, default 0.1).
